steps.what: Locate the accession, specimen history and available slide references in the {OTHER} laboratory information system
Examine microscopic samples to identify diseases or other abnormalities, including difficult areas and artefacts
Enter actual working observations and slide references in the {OTHER} laboratory case record, checking every observation
Save the working entry in the same {OTHER} laboratory case record

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} laboratory information system to open the accession-linked slide list and carry accession and slide identifiers into the working entry. The pathologist examines the samples and writes and checks the morphology; no image interpretation is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Context and slide identifiers may need repeated navigation and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and field defaults can remove those repeated actions.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle morphology, sampling limits and artefacts require specialist interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The pathologist decides what is abnormal and when more examination is needed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for laboratory access and clinical workflow review; consultation if staff monitoring changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: accession-linked case views and fixed identifier defaults can reduce navigation and re-entry without interpreting microscopy.

assumptions: Boundary is a specimen examination with an actual working observation entry, not a fabricated report after every look. Laboratory staff produce accession and slide references during existing specimen preparation; s1 verifies the match. Missing or conflicting identifiers stop defaults and require manual reconciliation within s1.

S3 counts the pathologist's observation capture and complete reading. Only fixed identifiers are carried; no clean morphology feed is assumed. Where observations are first recorded during examination, count that writing here once, not again in diagnosis or report preparation.

Test native configuration first. Existing case-linking runtime earns no saving. The 1 share on the same-system save is the schema minimum for negligible active effort and remains fully retained, without self-approval.

Shares are provisional work decomposition, not measured baselines. If no separate observation entry exists remove it and recalculate; if identifiers already carry through, there is no identifier-entry saving.
unknowns: Existing case view and identifier defaults
Actual observation-record practice and active effort
research_questions: Which navigation and identifier actions remain manual in observed specimen examinations?

already_counted.description: Specimen match and complete observation capture/check remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Check identifier defaults after laboratory configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.2, gross=4.8; upkeep 1 gives net 3.8. Low zero when native slide linking and observation defaults already remove the repeated entry, so do not add a duplicate configuration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and match the clinical question and specimen-linked results in the {OTHER} laboratory information system
Study the actual gross, histology, cytology or molecular findings and resolve discordant evidence
Diagnose diseases or study medical conditions by integrating findings and considering alternative explanations
Enter the actual diagnostic conclusion and limitations in the {OTHER} case record and check their meaning and case match
Save the diagnostic entry in the same {OTHER} case record

tasks.design: Use the {OTHER} laboratory information system's accession-linked result view and fixed case defaults. The pathologist reads the underlying evidence, reaches the diagnosis and records its limits; software neither diagnoses nor releases a report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant results and request context may be spread across case screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked-result views reduce repeated retrieval without changing interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting modalities, incomplete specimens and clinical uncertainty remain.
tasks.human_edge: The pathologist weighs evidence and takes responsibility for the diagnostic conclusion.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7 for clinical access and workflow review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked laboratory result views can reduce case navigation while leaving all diagnostic interpretation to a pathologist.

assumptions: This is a representative diagnostic case using already produced laboratory results. Laboratory staff and instruments produce the source records in existing testing work; s1 includes case-match and completeness checks. Missing results and discordance require human resolution, never invented values.

The actual diagnostic entry is separate from looking and reasoning. It may be the same writing later used in 17190; count it once across the tasks, and likewise do not add microscopic examination twice with 17194. The full pathology report and its release are not silently included in this entry.

Only case navigation and fixed identifiers change. Native defaults are tested first; existing integrations earn no new gain. No separate self-approval is added to clinical authoring; the ordinary same-system save is negligible, shown at minimum share 1 and fully retained.
Shares and cuts are hypotheses, not measured diagnostic baselines; the mix of techniques and complexity must be observed before extrapolation.
unknowns: Which entry is shared with report writing
research_questions: Does the native case view already assemble all relevant results?

already_counted.description: Case match, interpretation, diagnosis and actual entry checking remain.

incremental.description: Review linked-result and identifier configuration after laboratory changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94.85, gross=5.15; upkeep 1.5 gives net 3.65. Low zero for cases whose results already appear together and whose identifiers already default; avoid redundant configuration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the accession, source analyses and pathologist conclusions, capturing report section selections and any missing facts in the {OTHER} laboratory system
Transfer exact accession, specimen and result fields into the pathology report form in the {OTHER} laboratory system
Write pathology reports summarizing analyses, results, and conclusions in the {OTHER} report editor

loop.purpose: Draft wording only from verified findings and the pathologist's conclusion
loop.input: Verified source pack, section selections and diagnostic conclusion
loop.output: Draft narrative with source references for each assertion
loop.check: Pathologist compares every assertion, negation, limitation and conclusion against the source pack in s4
loop.stop: Missing support, conflicting result, changed diagnosis or failed comparison returns to manual writing; never invent a finding
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report templates remain first choice; a bounded wording draft is useful only for narrative variation they do not cover

steps.what: Complete and correct the whole report, checking clinical meaning, results, negation, uncertainty, specimen identity and all conclusions against original sources
Save the completed report in the same {OTHER} laboratory editor without releasing or sending it

tasks.design: Configure exact field transfer into the {OTHER} laboratory report form, then offer a bounded narrative draft only where native templates do not suffice. The pathologist supplies the conclusions and completes the entire report against original sources; saving does not release or communicate it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual field transfer and narrative composition consume effort even after diagnosis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report fields and constrained drafting can reuse actual verified case evidence.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent omission or altered negation can change clinical meaning.
tasks.human_edge: The pathologist determines what the report concludes and checks every clinical assertion.

ambition.what: No new diagnostic or release authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-12 for clinical data access, privacy and workflow assessment; staff consultation under national rules where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact report-field population is deterministic; constrained narrative drafting can assist writing but requires complete clinical source comparison.

assumptions: Boundary is writing the report, not diagnosing, clinical release or dispatch. Source analyses are produced in existing laboratory testing; the pathologist produces diagnostic conclusions in 17195 and verifies, selects and captures all drafting inputs in s1. Missing data are obtained manually and their effort remains in s1; unsupported text is not generated.

The representative episode has actual manual transfer of source fields. S2 is an explicit proposed machine action, not a discount to human review. Native field population already in use earns zero new saving. Templates are tested before a model; if they suffice use them and re-estimate actual writing effort.

S3 retained time includes edits and difficult-case manual fallback; s4 retains full original-source comparison. No new author self-approval is invented. Same-system save has no saving and uses schema minimum 1 for negligible effort. Actual clinical release or send, if included in a wider workflow, requires its own real authority and action after the final version exists.
Do not add conclusion/observation writing again when shared with 17194 or 17195. Shares are provisional, not a measured report-time benchmark.
research_questions: Can native templates eliminate the need for narrative generation?
Which assertions fail source comparison in a supervised trial?

already_counted.description: Source capture, draft editing and complete clinical report verification are already retained.

incremental.description: Maintain section mappings and examine samples after template/model changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=63.8, gross=36.2; upkeep 5 gives net 31.2. Conservative case: complex reports need full manual narrative composition and only 14 of the 25 transfer points are avoidable, giving 14-5=9; diagnoses and full source checks never shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the matched findings, source limitations and clinical question in the {OTHER} laboratory information system
Communicate pathologic findings to surgeons or other physicians in the clinical team, discuss uncertainty and answer their questions
Write the actual communication entry in the {OTHER} case record, capturing recipient, time, findings discussed and unresolved questions and checking its accuracy
Save the communication entry in the same {OTHER} case record

tasks.design: Use a case-linked view in the {OTHER} laboratory system and default only accession and available recipient identifiers into its communication form. The pathologist holds the actual conversation and writes and checks its clinical content; there is no automated clinical message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct case and repeating identifiers can interrupt clinical communication.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and fixed-field defaults can remove repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and responding to surgical context require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The pathologist recognises misunderstanding and adapts the explanation.

ambition.what: The same clinical colleagues receive the findings.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for clinical access and communication workflow review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: case-linked communication forms can reuse identifiers while the clinician supplies and checks discussion content.

assumptions: Representative episode is an actual intrateam physician discussion with a required case communication entry. It does not invent a note after every informal conversation. If no entry is actually made, remove that work and re-estimate; if the actual task is a written external handoff, model its writing, real authority and send separately.

Laboratory sources and clinical conclusions already exist; s1 verifies their case match and reads the evidence. S3 captures recipient, time and discussion meaning; only existing exact identifiers default, with manual fallback on mismatch. No audio transcript or structured discussion feed is assumed.

Native configuration first; existing context links and defaults earn no new gain. Saving in the same system takes negligible active effort, represented at minimum share 1 and fully retained without self-approval. This entry is not a duplicate of the diagnostic or full report text.
Shares are hypothetical active effort, not measured communication times. Physician participation is unchanged baseline work, with no transferred preparation or review.
unknowns: Mix of oral and written handoffs
research_questions: Which fields are repeated manually during actual clinical communication entries?

already_counted.description: Case reading, live explanation and actual communication capture/check remain.

incremental.description: Check context and recipient defaults after laboratory changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.1, gross=4.9; upkeep 1 gives net 3.9. Low zero if existing case links and identifier defaults already cover the actual communication entry; keep the clinical conversation intact.
